name: Wellness Escape
notes: Private wellness group. Keep the pace relaxed, limit hotel changes, and include one gentle outdoor experience.
groupDescription: A private wellness group of returning clients: a friendship group of long-standing travellers who book together once a year. Two of them have walked this trip with us before.
rooms: 8 twin rooms and 2 singles. One couple in a double, no triples. Two of the twins would take a double room if the price is the same.
dietaryAndMedical: Two gluten-free, one dairy-free, one vegetarian, one who cannot eat shellfish. No mobility restrictions, but two would rather not walk far in the heat, and one has a knee that dislikes stairs.
dateFirmness: Fixed to the second week of October, with up to three days of movement either way if it changes the price.
budgetBasis: land only, per person, excluding international flights
guestOrigin: Flying in from Seattle (SEA) and Vancouver (YVR) on different flights, arriving within a few hours of each other. They need meeting at the airport and one transfer on arrival.
dayShape: One main activity a day, a long lunch, and the late afternoon free. Two evenings together as a group, the rest open.
hardNos: no bus days over three hours
no more than one hotel change
